title: projects-list
description: Output of `maind projects list --json`: the project registry records as stored, optionally filtered by namespace. A record keeps every key of the registry (the set is open); the keys below are the ones consumers rely on.

local_path.description: Project directory on this machine (may start with ~); null when the record comes from the brain fallback without a repository.

vault_path.description: Vault folder of the project, when it has one; null when unknown.

namespaces.description: Memory namespaces the project belongs to; empty or missing means the default namespace.

enabled.description: False excludes the project from cross-project work; missing means enabled.

dependencies.description: Identifiers of the projects this one depends on.
